Policy only allows cancelling an entire pending order (with a valid reason), not partial item cancellation; partial modification of a pending order is also only possible via the once-per-order item-modification tool. If the order is processed/delivered, cancellation is impossible. Visible conversation shows no confirmed order id, no status check, no valid cancellation reason from the user, and no explicit confirmation, so the request as stated is likely to be denied or need a different workflow, risking task failure.
